# What A Rush Riding Stables & House of Grace

> Beachfront horseback riding, guided trail rides, horsemanship lessons, horse therapy, and the beachfront Cowboy Casita rental in Playa Cangrejera, La Libertad, El Salvador. Operated by Shawn and D'Arcy Burke with 30+ years of horsemanship experience.

## About

What A Rush is a beachfront horseback riding and adventure experience center located in Playa Cangrejera, La Libertad, El Salvador. We offer guided trail rides through scenic sugar cane fields, estuaries, and wooded trails, as well as horse/human therapy sessions, horsemanship training, and riding lessons for all skill levels. We also operate The Cowboy Casita, a fully furnished beachfront casita available for nightly and long-term rental.

## Pages

- [Home](https://whatarush.org/): Main page with full information about horseback riding services, our horses, The Cowboy Casita rental, and booking details.

## Services

- Guided Trail Rides: 1.5-2 hour guided rides through sugar cane fields, estuaries, and wooded trails. $60 USD per session. Tack and equipment provided.
- Horse/Human Therapy Sessions: Therapeutic sessions connecting horses and humans for healing and growth. Customized packages available.
- Horsemanship Training Lessons: Learn the art of horsemanship from experienced trainers. Customized packages.
- Riding Lessons: Structured riding lessons for all skill levels. Customized packages.

## Horses

- Sir Dante: Regal, well mannered Black Beauty gelding. Calm, intuitive, and responsive — suits beginners and advanced riders alike.
- Paco: Gentle gaited Peruvian Horse, smooth ride, perfect for intermediate or first-time riders.
- Congrejeto: Elegant Friesian Horse, gentle and patient, ideal for beginners and intermediate riders.
- Tequilla: Spanish gaited horse with spirit and endurance, best for experienced equestrians.
- Victorioso: Powerful and graceful, perfect for riders seeking adventure.
- Carbonero: Wise and experienced Spanish gaited horse, steady, calm, and reliable.

## The Cowboy Casita (Beachfront Rental)

Beachfront casita rental in La Libertad, El Salvador. Sleeps up to 5 guests, fully furnished and American standard, with private parking, internet, AC, pool, and direct access to the beach.

- By the night: $180 USD
- 1-year lease: $1,000 USD/month

Amenities: Beachfront location with direct beach access, Pool, Air Conditioning, Internet, Private Parking, Fully Furnished, American Standard fixtures. Electricity included in the nightly rate; billed separately on the long-term lease. Payment accepted in Cash and Bitcoin.
